N01.text: The “Christ” in “Jesus Christ” — / is it Jesus’ last name?

N02.text: The name that always comes / at the end of our prayers.

P1.text: John 1 · Andrew to his brother Simon (Peter)

Q1.text: We have found the Messiah / (which means Christ).

N03.text: Christ is not a last name. / It means “the Anointed One” — the Messiah.

N04.text: God anointed with oil / to set apart kings, priests, and prophets.

K1.text: Then Samuel took the horn of oil / and anointed him in the midst of his brothers.

K2.text: And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head

K3.text: … and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah / you shall anoint to be prophet in your place.
K3.voice: you shall anoint to be prophet in your place.

N06.text: Many people waited for the Messiah / only as a king who would drive out Rome.

N07.text: One day, after Jesus had come, / Peter made a confession.

Q2.text: You are the Christ, / the Son of the living God.

N08.text: From then on, Jesus said / he must suffer and be killed, / and on the third day rise again.

Q3.text: Far be it from you, Lord! / This shall never happen to you.
Q3.voice: Far be it from you, Lord!

N09.text: To Peter, a Christ who dies / made no sense.

N10.text: But that road / had already been written.

Q4.text: But he was pierced for our transgressions; / he was crushed for our iniquities;

N11.text: On the cross, / the cry of Jesus.

Q5.text: Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani? / … My God, my God, / why have you forsaken me?
Q5.voice: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?

N12.text: This cry is the first line of a psalm / written a thousand years before / by David, the anointed king.

Q6.text: My God, my God, / why have you forsaken me?

Q7.text: they divide my garments among them, / and for my clothing they cast lots.

N14.text: Beneath the cross, the soldiers / divided his garments and cast lots for his tunic.

N20.text: Peter, who once said “Far be it from you,” / met the risen Jesus — and then he preached this.

Q9.text: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth / with the Holy Spirit and with power. / He went about doing good …
Q9.voice: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. He went about doing good

Q11.text: … They put him to death by hanging him on a tree,
Q11.voice: They put him to death by hanging him on a tree,

Q12.text: but God raised him on the third day

N15.text: The suffering Christ was not a failure — / he was the way the Scriptures pointed to.

N17.text: “Christ” is not a last name. / It is the confession / that Jesus is that very Messiah.

Q14.text: … everyone who believes in him / receives forgiveness of sins through his name.
Q14.voice: everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.

Q13.text: You are the Christ, / the Son of the living God.
Q13.voice: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
